note: Every version each registered prompt declared on first-parent main and the release/1.6.1 train since the registry's first commit (2dcdfcf), and the text it had, as a fingerprint. A version missing from that walk is listed in unrecorded_versions with the reason. A version that existed only on a pull request's own commits and left no gap in the numbers would not show. A version keeps one text for life: a change to the text is a new version, added by scripts/prompt_versions.py, and tests/test_prompt_fingerprint_file.py fails when the registry holds a version this file does not, or a version whose text differs from the one recorded here. It cannot see an edit to this file in the same change: rewriting a recorded fingerprint to match a changed text passes it. That this file only grows is held by review of its diff. Walked from 2dcdfcf (the registry's first commit) along first-parent main and the release/1.6.1 train. first_seen is the first commit on that walk to show the entry.
